plan_summary: Install and configure Nginx on Ubuntu 24.04 by updating system packages, adding the official repository key, installing the server package, verifying the service status, and configuring basic security headers.
assumptions: The host has network connectivity to download packages.
The user has sudo privileges to install software.

tasks.title: Update system package lists and upgrade existing packages
tasks.objective: Ensure the local package index is current before installing new software.
tasks.rationale: Running apt update prevents conflicts between old dependencies and new versions, ensuring a stable installation environment.
tasks.expected_output: Command completes with no errors or warnings regarding outdated packages.
success_criteria: The command returns to the prompt without error messages.

tasks.title: Add the official Nginx GPG key and repository
tasks.objective: Import the necessary cryptographic key and add the Ubuntu 24.04 specific Nginx repository.
tasks.rationale: Adding the official repo ensures access to the latest stable version of Nginx compatible with Ubuntu 24.04 (Jammy).
tasks.expected_output: The GPG key is added and the repository source list entry is created.
success_criteria: The apt cache shows the new nginx package from the official repo.

tasks.title: Install Nginx server packages
tasks.objective: Download and install the Nginx web server binary and dependencies.
tasks.rationale: This step installs the core Nginx software, default configuration files, and required libraries.
tasks.expected_output: Nginx binaries are installed to /usr/sbin/nginx and config files to /etc/nginx.
success_criteria: The command reports successful installation of nginx.

tasks.title: Start and enable the Nginx service
tasks.objective: Launch the Nginx daemon and configure it to start automatically on boot.
tasks.rationale: Starting the service makes the web server operational immediately, while enabling ensures persistence across reboots.
tasks.expected_output: The Nginx process is running and listening on port 80.

tasks.title: Verify Nginx is serving content correctly
tasks.objective: Confirm the web server responds to HTTP requests with the default welcome page.
tasks.rationale: Functional verification ensures the installation was successful and the service is bound to the correct interface.
tasks.expected_output: A browser or curl request returns the Nginx default index.html content.
success_criteria: HTTP 200 OK response received with expected HTML content.

tasks.title: Configure basic security headers in default site
tasks.objective: Edit the default server block to include security headers like X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy.
tasks.rationale: Hardening the default configuration protects against common web vulnerabilities like clickjacking and XSS.
tasks.expected_output: The /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default file is updated with security directives.
success_criteria: Headers are present in the response headers when viewed via curl -I.

tasks.title: Restart Nginx to apply security changes
tasks.objective: Reload or restart the service to load the updated configuration.
tasks.rationale: Configuration changes do not take effect until the service is restarted or reloaded.
tasks.expected_output: Nginx restarts successfully without syntax errors.

tasks.title: Verify firewall allows Nginx traffic
tasks.objective: Ensure the system firewall (UFW) allows incoming connections on port 80.
tasks.rationale: Even with a running service, the host must allow inbound traffic to be accessible from external networks.
tasks.expected_output: Port 80 is allowed in the firewall rules.

tasks.title: Document installation steps and configuration
tasks.objective: Create a brief summary of the installed version, key config paths, and security settings applied.
tasks.rationale: Documentation aids in future troubleshooting and provides a record of the system state for compliance or audits.
tasks.expected_output: A text file containing version info, config paths, and firewall status.
success_criteria: Document is saved and contains accurate version number.
